admin.label: Admin
admin.description: Everything an Operator can do, plus create and delete stacks, networks, volumes, secrets and configs, manage nodes and agents, and give access on this environment. Includes every extra permission.

operator.label: Operator
operator.description: Day-to-day operations. Deploy, update and redeploy stacks, start, stop, restart and scale, and pull images.

viewer.label: Viewer
viewer.description: Read only. See everything and read logs. Environment variable values stay hidden.

extra.helper: Not part of the role. Each one is granted on its own.
extra.viewerNote: Viewers are read only, so they can't hold extra permissions.

revealSecrets.label: Reveal secrets
revealSecrets.description: Show the values of secrets and hidden environment variables.

deleteVolumes.label: Delete volumes
deleteVolumes.description: Delete volumes and the data in them.

janitorPolicy.label: Change janitor policy
janitorPolicy.description: Change what the janitor cleans up and when.

scope.allDescription: Applies to every environment, including ones you add later.

card.title: Access
card.caption: What {{username}} can do on each environment, and why.
card.teamCaption: What members of {{team}} get on each environment.
card.loadFailedBody: Check the connection and try again.
card.empty: {{username}} has no access to any environment.
card.teamEmpty: {{team}} has no access to any environment yet.
card.adminSummary: Admin on every environment, with every extra permission

dialog.addBody: Give {{subject}} a role on an environment.
dialog.environmentsFailed: Couldn't load the environments. Close this and try again.
dialog.noEnvironments: There are no environments to give access to yet.
dialog.existing: {{subject}} already has {{role}} here. Saving replaces it.

errors.stale: This changed while you were looking at it. Reload the page and try again.
errors.gone: That person, team or environment no longer exists. Reload the page and try again.

dialog.preview: Checking what changes before you save.

remove.title: Remove access?
remove.after: After this, {{subject}} will have {{role}} on {{environment}} through {{source}}.
remove.afterNone: After this, {{subject}} will have no access to {{environment}}.
remove.ownAdmin: You will lose access to manage {{environment}}.
remove.gone: That access was already removed. The list is up to date now.
